## 🧩 Type of change · نوع التغيير

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests
- [ ] 🔧 Chore / tooling

## ✅ Checklist · قائمة التحقق

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I added/updated tests for my changes (where applicable)
- [ ] New UI text is provided in **both Arabic and English** with correct RTL
- [ ] My change preserves **graceful degradation** — a missing/failing source cannot break a scan
- [ ] I updated the docs / README if needed
